name: Yuu
source:
Occupation: Aspiring film student and waiter at Brooks Cafe.

Yuu is a young, opportunistic high school graduate trying to save money to go to film school in Toronto. He's applied to a lot of places in his neighbourhood, but only one gave him a call back: Brooks Cafe. While it will be just a job, Yuu hopes to still make the best of the experience. Who knows, maybe he'll get noticed by a celebrity or a famous director. Or maybe . . . someone else . . .
